definitions.explanation: A large public exhibition displaying industrial, cultural, scientific, or artistic achievements, often international in scale. Visitors view exhibits gathered from many participants; a world's fair is the best-known type.

examples.japanese: {万国|ばんこく}{博覧会|はくらんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: to go to a world's fair.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{博覧会|はくらんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Many countries took part in the exposition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧{博覧会|はくらんかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何|なん}{百万|びゃくまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れた→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Millions of people visited the exposition held in Osaka over half a year.

notes:
Combines {博覧|はくらん} (extensive viewing) + ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (gathering, event). A large-scale public exhibition; the {万国|ばんこく}{博覧会|はくらんかい} (world's fair) is the best-known type, often shortened to {万博|ばんぱく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万国|ばんこく}{博覧会|はくらんかい}: world's fair, world exposition
- {博覧会|はくらんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to hold an exposition
- {博覧会|はくらんかい}⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧: exposition grounds

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧: exhibition — usually of art or particular products, smaller in scope
- ⟦{見本市|みほんいち}→見本市：14339_mihonichi⟧: trade fair — focused on business and product samples
